neighbours.label: ' to' after 'back' marking a return to a state (get back to normal, back to life)
fire: After the flood, life in the village slowly got back to normal.
The rain brought the dry garden back to life within a week.
She worked hard all summer to get back to the top of the rankings.
Once the strike ends, the trains should go back to their usual timetable.
It took months for the economy to return back to its old strength.
After the holidays the children are finally back to their routine.
The doctors brought the patient back to consciousness after an hour.
Things are getting back to normal at the office since the move.
quiet: After the flood, the villagers slowly began to clean the streets.
The rain made the dry garden green within a week.
She worked hard all summer to reach the top of the rankings.
Once the strike ends, the trains should keep their usual timetable.
It took months for the economy to regain its old strength.
After the holidays the children want to play outside all day.
The doctors decided to wake the patient after an hour.
Things are quieter at the office since the move.

notes: Card: ' to' x18, mostly 'back to' (back to the top, back to normal, back to life); the + pole is starting something in motion.
